text: They took your Crown. They left you a ghost.
Sixty seconds. Graze danger. Trigger your surge. Break the boss. Dare a friend to beat your ghost.
Every flight fuels the next. Recover salvage. Trade with MOTH. Craft your look. Sell to other pilots. Bring the city back to life.
Challenge HOUND. Ten credits in. Beat the ghost. Take the bounty. Miss, and the next challenge gets bigger.
A real game economy. Fixed supply. Replay-verified rewards. Your style changes. Your firepower doesn’t.
Your ghost. Their problem. Play RivalGhost.
